items.question: 지난주 세션 200개 이상인 유입 소스(traffic_source) 중 결제한 세션 비율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.sql:
WITH total AS (
    SELECT
        traffic_source,
        SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
    FROM agg_traffic_hourly
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
      AND summary_date <  date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    GROUP BY traffic_source
),
payments AS (
    SELECT
        traffic_source,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS payment_sessions
    FROM events
    WHERE event_name = 'is_payment'
      AND timestamp >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
      AND timestamp <  date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    GROUP BY traffic_source
)
SELECT
    t.traffic_source,
    t.total_sessions,
    COALESCE(p.payment_sessions, 0) AS payment_sessions,
    COALESCE(p.payment_sessions, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_sessions, 0) AS payment_rate_percent
FROM total t
LEFT JOIN payments p USING (traffic_source)
WHERE t.total_sessions >= 200
ORDER BY payment_rate_percent DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3;
